understanding: The task requires relocating the 'action-evidence DONE-guard' logic from driver/85-loop-mode-transitions.ps1 (lines 12-95) into driver/86-loop-completion-checks.ps1, placing it immediately after the status-parse block (after line 1027), within the cluster of DONE∧normal-guards, and before the done-gate at line 1433. This guard must trigger on every driver-turn. The goal is to eliminate spurious 'property/variable not found' errors (currently ~6 per session) and false 'DONE rejected' messages that occur on turns after a DONE has been accepted. The change is a control-plane edit affecting two driver files, requiring bridge_self_canary, operator authorization, canary testing with driver.ps1 -SelfTest and smoke.ps1, and rollback notes.
summary: Relocate the action-evidence DONE-guard from 85-loop-mode-transitions.ps1 (lines 12-95) to 86-loop-completion-checks.ps1, inserting it after status-parse (post line 1027) within the DONE∧normal-guard cluster and before the done-gate (line 1433). This ensures the guard evaluates on every driver-turn with correct variable scope, eliminating 'property/variable not found' errors and spurious DONE rejections. Deployment uses bridge_self_canary with operator authorization, includes SelfTest and smoke tests, and provides rollback instructions.

decision_atoms.statement: Extract the action-evidence DONE-guard block from driver/85-loop-mode-transitions.ps1 (lines 12-95) and remove it entirely from that file.
decision_atoms.reason: The guard currently resides in a file that handles loop mode transitions, where it may execute before necessary variables are populated, causing 'property/variable not found' errors. Relocation is required by the task constraints.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Removing the guard from 85-loop-mode-transitions.ps1 temporarily removes that check from the transition path until the new placement is active; this is acceptable because the guard will be immediately re-inserted in 86-loop-completion-checks.ps1 during the same deployment.

decision_atoms.statement: Insert the extracted DONE-guard code into driver/86-loop-completion-checks.ps1 immediately after the status-parse block (after line 1027) and before the done-gate (line 1433), within the DONE∧normal-guard cluster.
decision_atoms.reason: Placing the guard after status-parse ensures all status variables are populated. Positioning it within the DONE∧normal-guard cluster and before the done-gate ensures correct ordering relative to other done-logic, preventing spurious 'DONE rejected' messages.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: The exact insertion point must be carefully chosen to not disrupt existing guard logic; a minor risk of ordering issues with adjacent guards exists but is mitigated by testing.

decision_atoms.statement: Ensure the relocated guard triggers on every driver-turn by placing it in the main loop completion path of 86-loop-completion-checks.ps1, not inside a conditional branch that might skip execution.
decision_atoms.reason: The task requires the guard to trigger on every driver-turn. The loop completion checks file is invoked each turn, and placing the guard in the unconditional flow guarantees per-turn evaluation.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: This adds a small overhead to every driver-turn, but the guard logic is lightweight and the benefit of eliminating errors outweighs the cost.

decision_atoms.statement: Deploy the change using bridge_self_canary with operator authorization, running driver.ps1 -SelfTest and smoke.ps1 as canary tests.
decision_atoms.reason: The task constraints require canary evidence and operator authorization due to the control-plane nature of the edit. SelfTest and smoke tests validate basic functionality before full rollout.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Canary deployment adds procedural overhead but is necessary for safety given the high-risk classification.

decision_atoms.statement: Monitor the metrics 'property/variable not found' errors per session and 'spurious DONE rejected' events post-deployment to confirm they drop to zero.
decision_atoms.reason: These are the success criteria defined in the task. Continuous monitoring ensures the fix is effective and no regressions occur.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Requires active monitoring for at least one full session; this is standard practice for high-risk changes.

assumptions: The action-evidence DONE-guard code in lines 12-95 of 85-loop-mode-transitions.ps1 is a contiguous, self-contained block that can be cleanly extracted.
Line 1027 in 86-loop-completion-checks.ps1 marks the end of the status-parse block.
The DONE∧normal-guard cluster exists between status-parse and done-gate and has a logical insertion point for the relocated guard.
driver.ps1 -SelfTest and smoke.ps1 are available and functional for canary testing.
bridge_self_canary is a known deployment mechanism with operator authorization workflow.
The 'property/variable not found' errors are caused by the guard executing before status variables are initialized in the transition file.
No other code in 85-loop-mode-transitions.ps1 depends on the DONE-guard being present there.

risks.risk: Incorrect insertion point disrupts ordering of DONE-guard evaluations, causing new spurious rejections or missed DONE detections.
risks.mitigation: Carefully review the DONE∧normal-guard cluster structure before insertion. Use canary testing with driver.ps1 -SelfTest and smoke.ps1 to validate guard ordering. Have rollback notes ready.

risks.risk: Residual references to the moved guard in 85-loop-mode-transitions.ps1 cause syntax errors or broken dependencies.
risks.mitigation: Perform a full-text search for cross-references to the guard code before removal. Validate with PowerShell syntax check and SelfTest.

risks.risk: The guard code uses variables that are not in scope at the new insertion point in 86-loop-completion-checks.ps1.
risks.mitigation: Analyze variable dependencies of the extracted guard code. Verify all required variables are populated by status-parse (line 1027). If scope issues exist, adjust variable passing or guard code accordingly before deployment.

risks.risk: Canary deployment fails due to bridge_self_canary issues or operator unavailability, delaying the fix.
risks.mitigation: Coordinate operator availability in advance. Have a fallback manual deployment procedure documented.

risks.risk: The change inadvertently affects other control-plane logic relying on the original guard timing or location.
risks.mitigation: Run full regression suite (smoke.ps1) and monitor for unexpected behavior in related components post-deployment.
